faqs.q: Sec. 54-163. - Failure to comply with an enforcement order.
faqs.a:
(a)
A driver or registered owner who has been served with an enforcement order shall pay
               the civil penalty or otherwise comply with the order of the hearing officer or city
               manager or designee thereof issued pursuant to
section 54-161
above.
(b)
Notwithstanding any other provision of this division or of this Code, should a driver
               or registered owner fail to pay or otherwise comply with such an enforcement order,
               the city manager or designee thereof may petition the municipal court, setting forth
               the facts and circumstances of the case, and seeking that a show cause order be issued
               to the driver or registered owner. The municipal court is authorized to issue a show
               cause notice to the driver or registered owner to appear before the court and show
               cause why such payment was not made, under penalty of punishment for contempt.
(c)
Service of the show cause notice shall be made by mailing the notice to the last known
               address of the driver or registered owner by certified mail, return receipt requested,
               not less than seven calendar days prior to the time the driver or registered owner
               is required to appear in municipal court.
(d)
Should the driver or registered owner not appear in municipal court following service
               of the show cause order, the court is authorized to enter a default judgment in favor
               of the city for the amount of the citation and any late fees, and other administrative
               costs and fees.
(
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
